notes: Uno+CNC Shield migration baseline: A4988 with no microstep jumpers = full-step (1/1); TMC2208 standalone with no MS jumpers = 1/8. ORYN scales GRBL $100/$101 or FluidNC steps/unit by the physical microstep ratio. Internal 256 interpolation does not alter controller steps/unit. Exact 360-degree and center-to-perimeter calibration remains authoritative.
